title: Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy Diagnosis Based on Cardiovascular Magnetic Resonance Using Deep Learning Techniques
summary: Deep-learning analysis of cardiovascular magnetic-resonance images classified hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and controls; the preprint reports diagnostic performance against its labeled study data.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: The preprint evaluates deep-learning classification of labeled hypertrophic-cardiomyopathy and control CMR images; external clinical validation is not reported in the case checks.
evidence.unknown: The reported evaluation does not establish prospective benefit or performance beyond the studied setting.
evidence.ai_role: Classifies hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and control cases from cardiovascular magnetic-resonance images.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
